parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human Interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4 (IRAK4). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for human Interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4 (IRAK4). Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
